11 Pakistani Police Killed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ambush

At least 10, and feared to be 11, Pakistani police personnel were killed in an attack by terrorists in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The attackers reportedly opened fire on the police team from hilltops. One report indicated a senior police officer was among the dead.
